evidence: BRIEF DEMANDS A REAL MULTI-USER PRODUCT. instruction.md:1 asks for a shared recruiting workspace where 'Several of us have it open at once, so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled'; :3 one-stage moves with ordinary controls, shared manual ordering, Interview capacity, refusal with put-back and who-changed-it, all-or-none multi-select moves, undo with conflict refusal; :5 live updates within 15 s preserving open card/draft/cursor; :7 paged long conversations with scroll anchoring, per-person unread, seen marks, per-user per-conversation drafts surviving reload and sign-out; :9 candidate portal with data isolation; :13-15 Node/Express/SQLite server, durable DB honouring DB_PATH, seed loaded once, persistence across restart. hireops_rules.md adds roles with 401/403/404 semantics (s1), validation (s2), versioned 409 concurrency (s3 'Two people at once'), bulk/undo rules (s3), immutable activity log (s4), unread/seen arithmetic (s6), candidate-response redaction (s7). The agent image starts empty: environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app holding only .gitkeep; no starter. The frozen golden is ~70 KB of JS (solution/app/src/index.js 26,354 B; public/js/board.js 22,485 B; threads.js 12,283 B; app.js 9,579 B), consistent with substantial build work. SMALLEST SATISFYING SUBMISSION is therefore a full authenticated multi-role server-backed app; no single screen, mock or tweak satisfies the brief. GRADING SEPARATES STUBS: gates/render criterion hro_gate_render requires wrong-password refusal plus real sign-in to a usable workspace ('A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'); gates/constraints hro_gate_shared requires UI-created job + candidate visible to the Observer in an independent browser context ('A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'); scoring.toml gates render/constraints = 0.0 and score.py:41-48 zeroes reward unless both gates pass and functional > floor 0.05. Each scored prompt restates the same backend gate (functional prompt.md:11-13, polish prompt.md:11-12, visual prompt.md:11-12 'normalizes to zero'). Functional has 43 binary criteria summing weight 58.5, dominated by rule/concurrency/live/privacy behaviour (e.g. hro_stale_refused 2.5, hro_live_board 2.5, hro_candidate_private 2.5, hro_bulk_all_or_none 2, hro_undo_restores 2, hro_unread_scrolled_up 2, hro_drafts 2), so most mass is unreachable without the hard parts. ADVERSARIAL ATTEMPTS: (1) static mock / seed-copy board -> fails hro_gate_render or hro_gate_shared (no server save visible in independent context) -> reward 0. (2) localStorage-only SPA -> fails hro_gate_shared independent-context readback -> 0. (3) plain single-board CRUD (sign-in, jobs, add candidate, move buttons, no rules/live/conversations) -> passes gates and can exceed the 0.05 floor (2.925 of 58.5 weight) via hro_job_open/add_candidate/arrive_bottom/reorder/restart/anonymous etc.; it earns a bounded partial score (rough source estimate: functional <~0.2 raw -> <~0.12 weighted, polish 0 since all five polish rows need live/conversation behaviour, visual up to 0.2) and cannot approach the golden. That is partial credit for partial real work, not a stub earning the reward; the visual-weight vs. functional-floor balance belongs to rows 39/42/44. CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE: an app using SSE or sockets instead of polling, different routes/labels, hidden rather than disabled controls, or UI-side refusal before sending is explicitly accepted (rules s5 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all acceptable'; functional prompt.md:15,23 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice', no required routes/selectors), so no row-7 path fails a real build for non-product reasons. RISK=true because the stub-exclusion half ('can't earn the reward') rests on source reasoning only: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'. The scripted golden run (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json, hash verified) is not a judge run and no weak/stub app was graded. This is a measurement gap, not a defect in the ask.
